[LCCO.4.1] The compiler must name synthetic continuation rules
`$<outer>_<kind>_<N>`, where `<kind>` is `response`, `timeout`,
or `error`, and `<N>` is the source-order index among clauses of
that same kind within the outer rule. A synthetic name
([LLEX.10.6.1]) can't equal an author-written rule name.
